scripts.translation: 嗯，你看起來不夠可靠，沒法完成象牙交代的任務。

scripts.text: This place is like a paradise for adventurers. Not for weak ones like you, though.
scripts.translation: 這裡簡直是冒險者的天堂...不過可不適合你這種弱者。

scripts.text: The time is up to complete the existing tasks.
If you have any unfinished tasks in your quest log, they are considered 'failed' and removed from the log.
scripts.translation: 任務日誌裡還沒完成的任務會被視為“失敗”，並從日誌中移除。

scripts.text: Once they are removed, go talk to Elephantine and you can receive new tasks.
scripts.translation: 任務移除後，去找象牙談談，就能接新任務了。

scripts.text: Please wait a minute while I check the documents.
scripts.translation: 嗎？請稍等，我查一下記錄。

scripts.text: Yes, I see you've completed the task. It has been confirmed as completed.
scripts.translation: 嗯，記錄顯示你已經完成任務，確認無誤。

scripts.text: It may be a documentation error, but according to the documents, you have nothing to do with the tasks.
scripts.translation: .。可能是記錄出錯了，但檔案顯示你沒有接過這些任務。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，無法進行操作。丟掉一些再試試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你的負重太高，無法進行操作。減輕負重後再試試。

scripts.text: I try to give tasks only to reliable people. You are......... no, never mind.
scripts.translation: 我只把任務交給可靠的人。至於你嘛...算了，沒什麼。

scripts.text: You really have no clue. What could you do with such a weak body?
scripts.translation: 你真是什麼都不懂。就你這副瘦弱的身子，能做什麼？

scripts.text: I have no additional tasks available now. If I get some, I'll let you know when you come back.
scripts.translation: 我現在沒有其他任務。有新任務的話，你下次來我會告訴你。

scripts.text: Will you please check with the ^990099General Goods Dealer^000000
scripts.translation: 上次任務的詳情，請去找雜貨 ^990099^000000

scripts.text: on the details of the previous task?
I have some tasks for you - will you take a look at them?
scripts.translation: 。我這裡有些任務，你要看看嗎？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
Here, we make all kinds of supplies for adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我們在這裡為冒險者製作各種補給品。

scripts.text: We accept raw materials for the supplies once a day.
scripts.translation: 我們每天會收一次製作補給品所需的原材料。

scripts.text: Sometimes, we might ask for materials that are very difficult to obtain. In that case, try to get help from your fellow adventurers.
scripts.translation: 有時需要的材料很難弄到，遇到這種情況就找其他冒險者幫忙吧。

scripts.text: Let me see... what supplies are we making today...?
scripts.translation: 我看看...今天要做什麼補給品呢？

scripts.text: The adventurers here make sure to bring with them, on their exploration to dungeons, a preservative to keep their food fresh. Do you know what the preservative is made from?
scripts.translation: 這裡的冒險者進地下城探險時，都會帶上能讓食物保鮮的防腐劑。你知道它是用什麼做的嗎？

scripts.text: *grin* None other than... Insect Feelers! The General Goods Dealer there asked me to get four of them. I personally would not eat it for all the world...
scripts.translation: *咧嘴一笑* 沒錯，就是...昆蟲觸角！那邊的雜貨商要我弄四根來。要我吃這個？我可敬謝不敏...

scripts.text: These days, it's common for adventurers here to make talismans to protect themselves on their dangerous adventures. Like a kind of insurance.
scripts.translation: 最近，冒險者都喜歡做護身符，保佑自己冒險平安，就像買了份保險。

scripts.text: Immortal Hearts seem to be all the rage lately. The General Goods Merchant asked me to get five of them.
scripts.translation: 最近不死心臟很受歡迎。雜貨商要我弄五個。

scripts.text: They need tons of Rotten Bandages for making first aid bandages. They must have run out of new materials.
scripts.translation: 他們要用一大堆腐爛繃帶製作急救繃帶，看來新材料都用完了。

scripts.text: The client is the General Goods Merchant over there. Three bunches of them will be enough.
scripts.translation: 委託人就是那邊的雜貨商。給他三束就夠了。

scripts.text: Symbols of strong warriors give adventurers great support on their journeys. That's why Orcish Vouchers sell like hotcakes.
scripts.translation: 強大戰士的象徵能給冒險者不少鼓舞，所以獸人戰士之證賣得特別好。

scripts.text: The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Orcish Vouchers, which are to be used to make symbols of courage.
scripts.translation: 雜貨商要我弄三個獸人戰士之證，用來製作勇氣護符。

scripts.text: It seems to be rumored among adventurers that drinking powdered bones mixed with water helps boost their stamina.
scripts.translation: 冒險者之間流傳著一種說法：把骨頭磨成粉泡水喝，能增強體力。

scripts.text: The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Skel-Bones, which are to be used to make tonic.
scripts.translation: 雜貨商要我弄三根骷髏骨，用來製作補劑。

scripts.text: You have received the task ^880088{0}^000000. Open and see the quest window for the details.
scripts.translation: 你已接取任務 。開啟任務視窗檢視詳情。 ^880088{0}^000000

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你的負重太高，無法進行操作。減輕負重後再試試。

scripts.text: Hmm, you don't look reliable enough for Bow-wow's tasks.
scripts.translation: 嗯，你看起來不夠可靠，沒法完成汪汪交代的任務。

scripts.text: What could you do with that fragile body? Go get some exercise.
scripts.translation: 你這副弱不禁風的樣子能做什麼？先去鍛鍊鍛鍊吧。

scripts.text: The time is up to complete the existing tasks.
If you have any unfinished tasks in your quest log, they are considered 'failed' and removed from the log.
scripts.translation: 任務日誌裡還沒完成的任務會被視為“失敗”，並從日誌中移除。

scripts.text: Once they are removed, go talk to Bow-wow and you can receive new tasks.
scripts.translation: 任務移除後，去找汪汪談談，就能接新任務了。

scripts.text: Please wait a minute while I check the documents.
scripts.translation: 嗎？請稍等，我查一下記錄。

scripts.text: It may be a documentation error, but according to the documents, you have nothing to do with the tasks.
scripts.translation: .。可能是記錄出錯了，但檔案顯示你沒有接過這些任務。

scripts.text: I've received the items all right. It will be some time before I have another task for you, so why don't you visit the hot spring and relax?
scripts.translation: 東西都收到了。過段時間才會有新任務，不如先去溫泉放鬆一下吧。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，無法進行操作。丟掉一些再試試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你的負重太高，無法進行操作。減輕負重後再試試。

scripts.text: Can you please keep away from me? You're getting in the way.
scripts.translation: 能不能離我遠點？你擋著我了。

scripts.text: This place is not a nursery. Grow up and come back, and I'll gladly give you tasks.
scripts.translation: 這裡可不是托兒所。長大些再來，我很樂意給你任務。

scripts.text: I have no additional tasks available now. If I get some, I'll let you know when you come back.
scripts.translation: 我現在沒有其他任務。有新任務的話，你下次來我會告訴你。

scripts.text: Will you please check with the ^990099Commodities Dealer^000000, standing across from me,
scripts.translation: 關於上次任務的詳情，請去對面找日用品商 ^990099^000000

scripts.text: on the details of the previous task?
I have some tasks for you - will you take a look at them?
scripts.translation: 你。我這裡有些任務，要看看嗎？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
Bow-wow and I are in the same industry.
scripts.translation: 我和汪汪做的是同一行。

scripts.text: We are a manufacturer of adventurers' supplies.
scripts.translation: 我們專門製作冒險者用品。

scripts.text: My tasks won't be easy - you'd better prepare yourself.
scripts.translation: 我的任務可不輕鬆，你最好做好準備。

scripts.text: Hmm... What tasks are at hand today?
Some people just hang their talismans around their necks, but more people choose to seal them in special cases and carry them on their bodies.
scripts.translation: 有人把護身符掛在脖子上，也有更多人把它們封進特製的小盒子裡，隨身帶著。

scripts.text: Mementos serve as inspirations for designers of those cases. The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two of them.
scripts.translation: 紀念品能給護符盒的設計師帶來靈感。對面的日用品商人要我弄兩個。

scripts.text: Adventurers make sure to keep their talismans safe, because they could save their lives.
scripts.translation: 冒險者都會把護身符收好，畢竟關鍵時刻能救命。

scripts.text: The Commodities Dealer across from me seems to make protective cases out of Shells. I was asked to get three of them.
scripts.translation: 對面的日用品商人似乎想用貝殼做護符盒，讓我去弄三個。

scripts.text: Adventurers that go into the bushes of the Maze of the Hazy Forest always wear knee protectors.
scripts.translation: 進入迷霧森林迷宮的灌木叢時，冒險者都會戴上護膝。

scripts.text: The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get three Scale Shells, which are to be used to make knee protectors.
scripts.translation: 對面的日用品商人讓我弄三片鱗片外殼，用來製作護膝。

scripts.text: I have a task for you at hand, making a vaccine for possible poisonous insects.
scripts.translation: 我有個任務要交給你：製作一種對付毒蟲的疫苗。

scripts.text: The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two Venom Canines, which are to be used in the research of the substance.
scripts.translation: 對面的日用品商人讓我弄兩顆毒牙，用來研究這種藥劑。

scripts.text: It seems they have run out of the material for adding non-slip soles to shoes.
scripts.translation: 看來他們用來給鞋底防滑的材料用完了。

scripts.text: The Commodities Dealer across from me commissioned me to get five globs of Sticky Mucus.
scripts.translation: 對面的日用品商人委託我弄五團黏稠液體。

scripts.translation: 你已接取任務 。開啟任務視窗檢視詳情。 ^880088{0}^000000

scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，無法進行操作。丟掉一些再試試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你的負重太高，無法進行操作。減輕負重後再試試。

scripts.text: Well, Woof-grrr can't have given a weakling like you tasks.
scripts.translation: 哼，嗚汪怎麼可能把任務交給你這種弱者。

scripts.text: Go away! I can't concentrate on cataloging with you hanging around like that...
scripts.translation: 走開！你一直在旁邊晃悠，我沒法專心整理目錄...

scripts.text: The time is up to complete the existing tasks.
If you have any unfinished tasks in your quest log, they are considered 'failed' and removed from the log.
scripts.translation: 任務日誌裡還沒完成的任務會被視為“失敗”，並從日誌中移除。

scripts.text: Once they are removed, go talk to Woof-grrr and you can receive new tasks.
scripts.translation: 任務移除後，去找嗚汪談談，就能接新任務了。

scripts.text: Please wait a minute while I check the documents.
scripts.translation: 嗎？請稍等，我查一下記錄。

scripts.text: It may be a documentation error, but according to the documents, you have nothing to do with the tasks.
scripts.translation: .。可能是記錄出錯了，但檔案顯示你沒有接過這些任務。

scripts.text: I've received the items all right. I look forward to working with you again.
scripts.translation: 東西都收到了。期待下次再合作。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，無法進行操作。丟掉一些再試試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你的負重太高，無法進行操作。減輕負重後再試試。

scripts.text: Reliability is the primary quality needed in looking for lost souls. You don't look so reliable to me.
scripts.translation: 尋找迷失的靈魂，最重要的是可靠。在我看來，你還不夠可靠。

scripts.text: You need to have a strong spirit to do this task. I think you need a lot more discipline.
scripts.translation: 這項任務需要堅強的意志。我覺得你還得多磨練自己。

scripts.text: You still have marks of the haunting souls on your body.
scripts.translation: 你身上還留著遊蕩靈魂的印記。

scripts.text: You'll have to come back when the marks have disappeared.
You feel your mind has calmed down once again. You now have enough energy to go look for other souls, so talk to the Guide again.
scripts.translation: 你的心緒重新平靜下來了。現在有精力尋找其他靈魂了，再去找嚮導談談吧。

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
My job is to gather the remains of the souls haunting the forest and put them to rest.
scripts.translation: 我的職責是收集迷霧森林中徘徊的靈魂殘骸，讓它們安息。

scripts.text: There are countless souls trapped in the Maze.
scripts.translation: 迷宮裡困著數不清的靈魂。

scripts.text: Help them get their long-deserved rest.
scripts.translation: 幫它們獲得盼望已久的安息吧。

scripts.text: I'll show you the details of one of the lost souls.
scripts.translation: 我來告訴你一位迷失靈魂的情況。

scripts.text: ^660066Age 32. Comes from Midgard. Has been missing for 3 months since he went to the Maze of the Hazy Forest in order to collect the native plants. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: 年齡 32 歲，來自米德加爾特。三個月前為採集當地植物進入迷霧森林迷宮，此後失蹤。生還機率極低。 ^660066^000000

scripts.translation: 年齡 19 歲，是一名乘船從遙遠未知之地來的冒險者。兩個月前，他不顧穆拉居民勸阻，穿著單薄的緊身衣進入迷宮探險後失蹤。 ^660066

scripts.text: Even if he's alive, he would cause trouble to the rescue team.^000000
scripts.translation: 就算還活著，也會給救援隊添麻煩。 ^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age unknown. Has some mental illness. Went alone in order to purify the Maze of the Hazy forest. He insists that he has good ancestry but no one trusts him.
scripts.translation: 年齡不詳，患有精神疾病。獨自進入迷霧森林迷宮，聲稱要淨化那裡。他堅稱自己出身名門，卻沒人相信。失 ^660066

scripts.text: Disappearance period : 12 years. Not much chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: 蹤時間：12 年。生還機率極低。 ^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age 51. Used to be a big thief who stole famous swords from all around the world.
scripts.translation: 年齡 51 歲，曾是名震四方的大盜，專門偷 ^660066

scripts.text: Went missing in the Maze after being pursued for running an illegal casino house which caused massive casualties in his final years. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: 竊各地名劍。晚年因經營非法賭場、造成大量傷亡而遭到追捕，之後在迷宮中失蹤。生還機率極低。 ^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age 22. An apprentice of an airship pilot. He has gone missing while drinking in Mora town, where he went for a break.
scripts.translation: 年齡 22 歲，是飛空艇駕駛員的學徒。他去穆拉鎮休假時喝酒後失蹤。據說 ^660066

scripts.text: Rumor has it that he fled after signing somewhere. Disappearance period : 4 months. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: 他在某處簽了字，隨後便逃走了。失蹤時間：4 個月。生還機率極低。 ^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age Unknown. A female with long hair, dressed in black. Went on an expedition to the forest of the Maze in search of eternal life. Disappearance period : 3 months. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: 年齡不詳，女性，留著長髮，身穿黑衣。為了尋找永生，她進入迷霧森林探險。失蹤時間：3 個月。生還機率極低。 ^660066^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age around 50. The current Mayor of the Mora village. He ran away to the Forest of Maze after being caught pocketing profits by cheating the residents. Survival uncertain.^000000
scripts.translation: 年齡約 50 歲，是穆拉村現任村長。因被發現欺騙村民、中飽私囊而逃進迷霧森林迷宮。生死不明。 ^660066^000000

scripts.translation: 的年輕男子。他謊稱要在穆拉創業、融入當地，騙走村民 1,200 枚穆拉村硬幣後逃進迷霧森林迷宮。生死不明。 ^000000

scripts.translation: 年齡 34 歲，曾在穆拉勾搭多名女性，之後被村民追趕著逃進迷霧森林迷宮。生死不明。 ^660066^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age Unknown. Disappered with coins which were joint controlled by the villagers. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: 年齡不詳，帶著村民共同管理的錢款失蹤。生還機率極低。 ^660066^000000

scripts.translation: 已找到失蹤者  的相關資訊。請檢視任務視窗瞭解詳情。 ^990099{0}^000000

scripts.text: I don't know whether to believe this art dealer... He made me stand here like this for days.... Ah... I feel dizzy.
scripts.translation: 不知道該不該相信那個藝術品商人...他讓我在這裡站了好幾天...唉...我頭都暈了。

scripts.text: I don't know when carving my pendant will be completed. Since he is a reliable art dealer, I suppose he won't break my pendant.
scripts.translation: 不知道他什麼時候才能刻好我的吊墜。既然他是個可靠的藝術品商人，應該不會把吊墜弄壞吧。

scripts.text: You Bastard! I want my rugged outwear! That was passed on to me by my father *SOB*
scripts.translation: 你這個混蛋！把我的厚外套還給我！那可是我爸傳給我的！嗚...

scripts.text: ^990099 It seems that he has gotten a great deal of damage from the art dealer.^000000

scripts.translation: 我們是傳奇的鄰里騎士團，五分鐘前才剛成立！

scripts.translation: 我們有四個首領，卻連一個小兵都沒有.

scripts.translation: 那些傢伙全是士兵，只有我是老闆！我

scripts.translation: 你當初勸我加入騎士團，現在看看這爛攤子！

Why not dump some of them in my pocket?
scripts.translation: 要不要放幾樣到我口袋裡？

because I've been sending random people on errands.
scripts.translation: ？我都糊塗了，最近一直隨便找人跑腿。

scripts.text: I'll reward you as I promised.
it's the Order of the Neighborhood Knights's work, right?
scripts.translation: 知道這是鄰里騎士團的功勞吧？
